an5.99:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sīho bhikkhave, migarājā sāyanhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhamati.
an5.99:1.4: samantā catuddisaṃ anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīhanādaṃ nadati.
an5.99:1.6: so hatthissa cepi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaññeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ
an5.99:1.7: mahisassa cepi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaññeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:1.8: gavassa cepi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaññeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:1.9: dīpissa cepi pahāraṃ deti, sakkaccaññeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:1.10: khuddakānaṃ cepi pāṇānaṃ pahāraṃ deti antamaso sasabiḷārānampi, sakkaccaññeva pahāraṃ deti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:2.1: sihoti kho bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammā sambuddhassa.
an5.99:2.2: yaṃ kho bhikkhave tathāgato parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, idamassa hoti sīhanādasmiṃ.
an5.99:2.3: bhikkhūnaṃ cepi bhikkhave tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti, sakkaccaññeva tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:2.4: bhikkhunīnaṃ cepi bhikkhave tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti. sakkaccaññeva tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:2.5: upāsakānaṃ cepi bhikkhave tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti, sakkaccaññeva tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:2.6: upāsikānañcepi bhikkhave tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti, sakkaccaññeva tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ.
an5.99:2.7: puthujjanānañcepi bhikkhave tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti antamaso annahāranesādānampi, sakkaccaññeva tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti no asakkaccaṃ.
